title: TheQuartering’s K Cup Crisis PR & Crying Victim After Starting War with Kino Casino (Jul 14, 2026)
episode_summary: A clip of TheQuartering defending his coffee business against claims that it is dropshipping. He explains his supplier, roasting, flavour development, fulfilment and K-Cup arrangements; says critics contacted and visited business partners; and frames the scrutiny as harassment. The clip is his response and does not independently verify either side.

evidence.note: First-person monologue about his coffee business and critics.
Business model and K-Cup production are the sustained subject.
Critics are attacked indirectly; exact identities are not always named in the clip.

chapters.title: Coffee business model defence

chapters.title: K-Cup label and equipment explanation
chapters.summary: He explains the shipping label, outsourced K-Cup packaging and why buying machinery was postponed.

chapters.title: Harassment and victimisation framing
chapters.summary: He says critics contacted or visited partners and portrays the investigation as harassment rather than transparency work.
